scenes.text: Claude built a link shortener with one hard rule. Only real visits are counted. Slack previews and bots are recorded, but never counted, and a QR scan counts apart from a click.

The test build found sixty-nine gaps. No setting held the company email domain. A Slack preview could use up a sign-in link. And typing f b into the source field could never be tried. All sixty-nine are fixed.
Bitly starts at ten dollars a month. But it limits how often a link's destination can change, and multiple users are an Enterprise addition. If your team shares links, build your own.
